component.name: Deptheos
component.summary: Focus stacking for macro photography, on the GPU

description.p: Deptheos is a free, open-source focus stacker for macro photography. The stacking runs on the GPU, so a stack of 200 frames at 45 MP is aligned and stacked in seconds.
Three methods (pyramid, depth map and wavelet), RAW in, linear DNG out, batch with auto sort, and a history that keeps every render. The deptheos command stacks from the terminal.
